Show Victoire Pisa (Casual Wear)

Wiping sweat, etc.

—There are people who would grieve for you.
Even if you feel completely alone, those connections are still alive.

Just leave me alone! Everyone wants to get rid of me anyway!
No matter what happens to me, it'd just be a relief to them!

I don't know how much I can achieve on my own.
Even so... even things I couldn't do back then... I believe I can, someday.

...!
A fire in such a narrow alley...

Why should I trust anyone?! When I was in trouble, nobody helped me!
I'm all alone in this world now!
...Yes, you are right.

If he truly resented you, why would he be so worried?
If he didn't care, why would he recall fond memories of the past?

...I want to see everyone again.
I want to smile and run together. So... I'll keep running from now on.

It's dangerous here, get back!
Come on! Hurry up!
——...Are you... crying...?

...Haha. What a strange girl you are.
But... thank you. You're very kind, little lady.

Um, the lady living on the second floor is still inside...
I banged on the door and called out, but she won't listen to a word...!

Granny! ...I'm sorry. When you were having a hard time,
if only I'd listened to you more, you wouldn't have felt so all alone.

From now on... let's talk more, like we used to.
I'm not the only one who remembers how much you looked out for us back then.

Just downstairs,
I met someone you used to play with when they were little.

In the end, no casualties were reported. Still, ordinarily,
one wouldn't go to such lengths to rescue a total stranger.

...Daddy. If I never stop running...
will everyone come back to me...?

It made sense why no straightforward goal had been visible.
It was simply so grand that a narrow perspective couldn't grasp it.

The building is...! 
Where is everyone...?!

Even with misunderstandings and estrangement, facing each other can reconnect those bonds.
So—please. Come with me.

I'm sorry for causing you worry.
However—I'm just so glad everyone is safe.
Because I want to connect people—perhaps?

No matter who it is—
there is never any excuse to let someone be in danger!

Excuse me, did you evacuate from inside? Please stay calm.
Also... have all the current residents safely made it out?

These hands—are meant to reach out to those who are lonely.
These legs—are meant to inspire hope by carrying me forward.

She was so kind and used to play with me all the time when I was a kid...
Dammit... what should I do...?!

—Many girls grew terrified of running
and walked away from racing altogether.
Huh...?

Smoke was pouring from a room on the fourth floor of an old mixed-use building in the alley.
A few people who looked like residents were staring up in distress.

All the sadness and loneliness...
If everyone holds hands together, I know we can make things happy again!

Let alone a student with no duty to act. She bore no such responsibility.
And yet, she didn't hesitate for a single second.

Standing by others. Connecting our hearts. Banishing loneliness from this world.
I believe that doing so will one day form a circle of hope uniting the entire world.

My parents, the encouraging adults, the friends running beside me.
Racing gave my young self so many precious connections.

That granny doesn't trust people anymore.
Ever since she got scammed, she completely shut herself off...

That purpose extended beyond daily life, directly into what she
wanted to accomplish through racing.
I'm right here with you.

...It's an old building. There's no telling how fast the flames will spread.
We have to get her out before the danger reaches her.

...There is no such person here.
Everyone is worried sick about you.

Yeah!
Let's all do our best and go to Tracen Academy together!

Fufu... I'm so glad...
That you chose to believe in the last remaining connection you had.

——Ah... I'm sorry for making you worry.
You too... young Umamusume lady.
—Even so.

(The hallway is dark... Fire must have broken out from the outdated electrical equipment...
I need to hurry so she can evacuate without panicking.)

If the fire spreads, it will become dangerous here too.
...Please evacuate with me.

—However, unreasonable tragedies...
can sever those connections with cruel ease.

A fire broke out at the local junior training facility.
Thankfully, there were no casualties, but—
Pisa-chan...! I'm scared, I'm so scared...!

—Yes.
Because I know you're going to be all right now.

Pure, unadulterated selflessness. The wish to "connect hearts with others and weave hope"
was the guiding beacon of her entire life.
——...I want to weave hope.

...Ever since that fire, it's gotten pretty lonely around here.
I doubt things will ever go back to the way they were...
Pisa-chan, run with me next time!

Touching upon feelings so entirely pure and precious,
I felt something warm stirring deep within my chest.
You'd like to know my motive...?

After a brief conversation, we were able to convince the resident to come outside.
The fire department arrived, and luckily, the fire was suppressed before causing major damage.
